product.description: Monoprice™1‑Gang Cable Plate with Flexible Opening, BlackAchieve a Clutter‑Free Setup with Flexible Cable RoutingThe 1‑Gang Cable Plate with Flexible Opening, Black offers a clean, professional, and efficient solution for managing cables in residential and commercial installations. Designed with functionality and aesthetics in mind, this cable plate allows installers, contractors, and DIY enthusiasts to pass low‑voltage cables through walls without the clutter or damage often caused by exposed wiring. Its sleek black finish blends seamlessly with modern electronics and décor, delivering both performance and style.What sets this cable plate apart is its flexible opening, which accommodates multiple cables of varying sizes while maintaining a neat and organized appearance. The pliable opening provides enough give to allow HDMI®, coaxial, audio, and network cables to pass through effortlessly, yet it closes snugly around them to minimize gaps and conceal the wall opening. This makes it an ideal choice for home theater systems, office setups, or any application where multiple low‑voltage cables need to be routed cleanly.Unlike traditional cable plates that require a separate low‑voltage mounting bracket, the 1‑Gang Cable Plate simplifies installation with integrated, molded‑in mounting wings built directly into the plate. These wings extend and tighten against the drywall as the screws are turned, creating a secure, reliable hold that eliminates extra parts and streamlines the installation process. This feature not only saves time and labor but also ensures that the plate remains firmly in place, even when subjected to the stress of repeated cable adjustments.The low‑profile, single‑gang design is perfect for spaces where minimal wall disruption is desired while still delivering maximum functionality. Its compact footprint makes it especially useful behind flat‑panel TVs, entertainment centers, or workstations where space is limited but cable organization is essential.Durability is another key strength of the 1‑Gang Cable Plate. Constructed from high‑quality materials, it's built to withstand frequent use while retaining its professional appearance. The black finish is both modern and versatile, complementing electronics, wall mounts, and audio‑visual equipment commonly found in today's homes and offices.Whether you're a professional installer or a homeowner tackling a DIY project, the 1‑Gang Cable Plate with Flexible Opening provides a practical, stylish, and user‑friendly solution for cable management. Its combination of secure mounting, flexible design, and sleek finish ensures that your installation not only performs well but also looks polished and clutter‑free.Designed for clean and professional
